component_state_meanings.required: The component must appear in later topic-level content coverage.
component_state_meanings.supporting: The component may be used when it improves explanation or AP-style reasoning at the established teacher depth.
component_state_meanings.not_primary: The component is not required as a primary representation for this topic.
